title: ARKNIGHTS X THE LEGEND OF LUO XIAOHEI COLLABORATION STORY COLLECTION EVENT: IT'S BEEN A WHILE
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X THE LEGEND OF LUO XIAOHEI] COLLABORATION STORY COLLECTION EVENT: IT'S BEEN A WHILE
EVENT DURATION: April 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 17, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Nutritional Pet Food Tins, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: It's Been A While event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Nutritional Pet Food Tins by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Stray Animal Shelter. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
[STRAY ANIMAL SHELTER] DURATION: April 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 17, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[STRAY ANIMAL SHELTER] MAIN REWARDS:
Event Bonus Operator [★★★★: Luo Xiaohei], Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
NOTE:

[Arknights X The Legend of Luo Xiaohei] Collaboration Operator [Luo Xiaohei] is currently ONLY available to be obtained from the event It's Been A While, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Special Operation. After the event ends, the event stories will NOT be recorded in Special Operation.
02 NEW OPERATOR AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operator will be added to the game.
★★★★: Luo Xiaohei
NOTE:
Operator Luo Xiaohei will gain more trust during this event.
03 [ARKNIGHTS X THE LEGEND OF LUO XIAOHEI] COLLABORATION SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: April 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Luo Xiaohei Collab Series – Spring Praise for Suzuran
- Luo Xiaohei Collab Series – Before Singing for Rockrock
04 RECORD RESTORATION: MARIA NEARL
UPDATE TIME: April 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Maria Nearl will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.
05 SPECIAL PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DURATION: April 7, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Packs will be available at the Store, including:
Strength Gift Package
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 13, Headhunting Permit * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 50, LMD * 100000, Manganese Ore * 5, Oriron Cluster * 5, Guard Chip * 3
Special Training Package
CONTENTS:
Originite Prime * 20, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 25, LMD * 100000, Skill Summary - 3 * 16, Guard Chip Pack * 5
